_comment: Where inference runs. Copy to config/inference.json and edit; that file is gitignored
because a hosted entry's apiKey belongs in it.
Any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint works. Two things are non-negotiable
for this app: the endpoint must honour response_format json_schema, and it must not sit
behind a proxy that silently drops it. A proxy that accepts response_format, forwards the
request without it and returns prose with finish_reason 'stop' is indistinguishable from
a model that ignored the schema, and cost a day to diagnose — point at the upstream.
default          which host below to use.
INFERENCE_HOST   environment override, for switching without editing the file.
${VAR}           substituted from the environment at load time; keep real keys in .env.
contextLength    used to size batches. Set it honestly: too high truncates JSON mid-object
maxOutputTokens  and the whole batch is lost.
